answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the canyon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short.
